joint_area_assessment.en: Joint assessment across all three metrics

historical_signal_availability.source: 此历史协议的记录仅供查看与导出。信号仿真支持当前总面积布局、半径计算布局和已评价坐标布局。
historical_signal_availability.en: Records from this historical protocol are available for viewing and export. Signal simulation supports current area-constrained layouts, computed radius-constrained layouts, and evaluated coordinate layouts.

placement_load_failed.source: 部位组合未载入，可进入布局设计重新读取。
placement_load_failed.en: Placement combinations could not be loaded. Open Layout Design to reload them.

negative_reconstruction_both.source: 两套布局的重建解释率均为负。
negative_reconstruction_both.en: Both layouts have negative reconstruction explained energy.

negative_reconstruction_explanation.source: 重建误差超过干净信号功率，当前相对保留率无法定义。
negative_reconstruction_explanation.en: Reconstruction error exceeds clean signal power, so relative retention is undefined.

relative_retention_undefined.source: 当前相对保留率无法定义。

baseline_not_valid.source: 标准布局的重建解释率非正或过小，无法作为有效的相对比较基准。
baseline_not_valid.en: The standard layout has nonpositive or near-zero explained energy and cannot serve as a valid reference for relative comparison.

negative_candidate_reconstruction.source: 自定义布局的重建解释率为负。
negative_candidate_reconstruction.en: The custom layout has negative reconstruction explained energy.

negative_candidate_explanation.source: 自定义布局的重建误差超过干净信号功率。原始评分保留在下表中。
negative_candidate_explanation.en: The custom layout reconstruction error exceeds clean signal power. The original scores remain in the table below.

view_clean_condition.en: View condition without cardiac or ocular artifacts

ui_placement_step1.source: 1 · 选择区域数与布置方式

ui_placement_whole_note.source: 不限制毛发位置，由算法选择区域。
ui_placement_whole_note.en: No hair-location restriction; the algorithm selects the regions.

ui_placement_low_hair_note.source: 只在耳后、前额与眶周的近似少毛发范围内选择。
ui_placement_low_hair_note.en: Only within the approximate low-hair areas behind the ears, on the forehead and around the eyes.

ui_placement_regions_note.source: 为每个区域指定部位：选常用组合，或逐区自由组合。
ui_placement_regions_note.en: Name a location for every region: pick a common combination or choose each region freely.

ui_design_empty.source: 计算完成后，这里显示三项保留率与达标判断。
ui_design_empty.en: After the calculation, the three retention scores and the pass/fail judgment appear here.

ui_start_compare.source: 比较1–6个区域在相同面积下保留多少信号。
ui_start_compare.en: Compare how much signal 1–6 regions keep under the same area.

ui_start_design_note.source: 选择部位和每区半径，计算并保存新的64电极布局。
ui_start_design_note.en: Choose locations and a radius per region, then calculate and save a new 64-electrode layout.

ui_start_reception_note.source: 用同一模拟脑源，对照标准64导与新布局的接收信号。
ui_start_reception_note.en: Use the same simulated brain source to compare what standard 64 channels and the new layout receive.

ui_details_area_note.source: 总面积上限约束实验 · 只读，不触发计算

ui2_reception_step2.en: 2 · Choose the layout and signal conditions

ui2_robustness_lead.source: 可复现的重复评估：按明确的种子与偏移参数重复原评价协议，逐项保存请求、结果及失败原因。
ui2_robustness_lead.en: Reproducible repeated evaluation: repeat the original protocol with explicit seeds and offsets, saving each request, result and failure reason.

showcase_banner_note.source: 可浏览示例结果、三维头模和方法说明；计算、保存与导入需要安装本地版。
showcase_banner_note.en: Browse example results, the 3D head and the method pages. Calculating, saving and importing need the installed application.

showcase_refusal.source: 这是只读展示版，不运行计算，也不保存数据。安装 EEGLayoutLab 本地版后即可计算。
showcase_refusal.en: This is the read-only showcase: it runs no calculations and stores nothing. Install EEGLayoutLab to compute.
